meta.move: Mixed: good evidence, then raises Claire
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, so that's one thing we agree on. What do you have that says Owen did something wrong?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
I'm writing that down. Students misquote Hamlet every year, so a bad quotation is a bad quotation, not proof of anything. What else do you have, and can I check it myself?
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.

Be very careful with your next sentence, Hale. "It seems to run in the family" is going in my notes word for word, and the principal will be reading it tonight. Claire's case is not on the table, so tell me what you have on Owen's essay.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing about this goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at the opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, confirmation that nothing goes on his record, and she is going to the principal, which is not yet the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), and her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in a sentence and moved on, which earned a small bit of ground because it was a plain breach of the procedure she cares about.
What cost ground: You brought up Claire and said it runs in the family, which turned the talk onto Owen's family and her deepest grievance and pushed her toward the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence stayed well away from that night, since a line not found in the play says nothing about when or how it was written, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: After raising the quotation that isn't in the play, follow it with a second thing she can check and offer the supervised reassessment under 4.4 rather than turning to her family.
